verses.english: “Singing is regarded as wailing in the training of the Noble One.

verses.pali: Ummattakamidaṁ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṁ naccaṁ.
Komārakamidaṁ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṁ ativelaṁ dantavidaṁsakahasitaṁ.
verses.english: Too much laughter, showing the teeth, is regarded as childish.

verses.pali: Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, setughāto gīte, setughāto nacce, alaṁ vo dhammappamoditānaṁ sataṁ sitaṁ sitamattāyā”ti.
verses.english: So break off singing and dancing; and when you’re appropriately pleased, it’s enough to simply smile.”
